title: Modularity
hook: Change one thing, break three others. Your business is too tangled.
statement: Systems work better when the parts can separate.
explainer: Fused parts make every fix risky. Separate parts can be swapped or delegated.
sop: Mark where functions depend on each other.
Split the most tangled pair cleanly.
Give each part its own owner.
equation_example: 3 Independent Modules, so Flexibility = 3. At 1, one change risks everything.
question: Name the tangled part you'd separate first.
closing_statement: Separate parts move faster than fused ones.
